name: High Chancellor Renn Valcor
notes: Entity record created 2026-08-09 to close a structural gap: this character existed ONLY as a charforge capsule, with no entity record, while being referenced by entity records (e.g. vessel crew_ids / commanding_officer_id). It therefore dangled from the entity graph and was silently omitted by every tool that indexes entity records. Core fields derive from the capsule, which is the authoritative existing canon; nothing was invented.

archive_profile.reputation: +10 Senate Influence, +4 Military Respect, -3 Separatist Trust
archive_profile.relationships: Close Political Ally of Zylox, Wary of Norr, Respected by Corporate Leaders
archive_profile.recent_actions: Negotiated Defense Spending Approval, Strengthened Civil Liberties Protections, Brokered AI Citizenship Vote
archive_profile.personality_insight: Keeps handwritten correspondence with citizens across the Union to stay grounded.
archive_profile.basis: Recovered verbatim from the archived Galactic Union character master lists; non-conflicting discovered detail reconciled per the standing rule.

naming_exemption.reason: Name preserved verbatim from the committed charforge capsule (canon/L2/entities/renn_valcor/capsule/identity.json).

capsule_binding_note: Explicit bridge between the two identifier namespaces. Relational fields across canon (crew_ids, commanding_officer_id, task_group_commander_id) refer to this entity by its CAPSULE id "renn_valcor", while the record identity is "char_renn_valcor". Before this field the two were connected only by stripping a prefix and hoping; tools/canon_reference_integrity.py now checks the bridge instead of guessing it.

political_alignment.platform: Senate control over economic security, and Union-backed military intervention.
political_alignment.standing: As Speaker of the Senate, described as one of the most powerful civilian figures outside Zylox, and a stabilising force for legislation — consistent with the recorded Senate Stabilizer profile and +10 Senate Influence.

leadership_grouping.note: A source-side grouping of senior figures, not a recorded office. Placed here as an attested association rather than as an org binding.

open_referents.claim: Named once, as a membership list — Zylox, Valcor, Saros — with a platform of Senate economic control and Union-backed military intervention.
open_referents.canon_state: No record; the name appears nowhere else in canon.
open_referents.why_not_minted: A single membership list does not establish whether this is a formal Senate caucus or a descriptive alignment. Minting an organisation from it would overstate what the source says.

prose_ledger_triage.excluded: Three claims are production metadata about building the character profile — "here is the JSON character profile", "profile has been successfully stored", and a note that the master list was reconstructed and exported. One further claim records that Valcor was earlier referenced as "High Chancellor Valcor" and later given a full name, which canon already carries as an alias.
